description: This file declares the WebAudioPlayerClient class, which implements the IWebAudioPlayerClient interface for IPC communication related to web audio playback. It includes constructor, destructor, and a method to notify state changes, along with private members for handle and IPC client reference.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerClient
classes.description: Implements the IWebAudioPlayerClient interface for IPC communication related to web audio playback.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerClient
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the client with a handle and IPC client reference.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Notifies the client of a change in WebAudioPlayerState.
